headline: Frontline Flare-Ups Persist Amid Soaring Casualties
war_summary: Since the early‑morning edition the map has shown a mixed picture: Fishermans Row erupted with two fresh captures in the last two hours, pushing its daily tally to twenty‑one flips and driving both sides’ loss rates above 170 and 240 per hour, while enlistments surge. Linn Mercy, the day’s busiest sector, has quieted in the past two hours after four rapid exchanges, yet its casualty curves remain steeply accelerating at roughly 260 and 280 per hour. Lykos Isle and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily — each recording >100 casualties per hour — though neither has registered a new ownership change since the last dispatch. Endless Shore and Stlican Shelf remain dormant, with no fresh flips since yesterday, while Weathered Expanse and Clahstra exhibit sharply rising attrition without territorial movement. Overall, base turnover is concentrated in a handful of contested hexes, while rear‑area sectors bleed manpower in static fights.
